propositions: Every typed configuration field emitted through _SECTION_CLASSES must have a nonempty public_description metadata field that describes user-visible effects or operational consequences, not restating type, default, or lifecycle.
The configuration reference generator must fail when an emitted field lacks a description, with the offending key named in the error output.
Generated descriptions must be co-located with dataclass fields to ensure single-source-of-truth consistency and prevent drift from a separate registry.
The generator must render a Description column in docs/config-reference.md with proper Markdown table escaping and must validate that all 100+ generated rows contain substantive descriptions.
Module-size limits must be maintained with src/rebar/_config_schema.py and src/rebar/_config_schema_verify.py each staying under 800 lines after field-local metadata is added.
